raw.jobDescription:
At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you.

Position Summary

ExtraHop is at the forefront of innovation in the cybersecurity space, delivering cutting-edge solutions to protect organizations against evolving threats. Our Network Detection and Response (NDR) products empower businesses to detect, respond to, and mitigate cyber risks in real time.

We seek a Principal Software Engineer to join our product development organization and serve as a technical anchor on our NDR platform. In this role, you will drive the architecture and execution of complex, high-impact engineering initiatives that define the future of our products. You will operate with significant autonomy, influence engineering direction across teams, and mentor engineers at multiple levels while delivering software that addresses the most sophisticated challenges in network security.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, write, and maintain robust, high-performance software to deploy AI/ML models that analyze network traffic for anomalous or malicious behaviors.
  • Design and develop autonomous AI agent architectures and multi-agent workflows.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, threat researchers, and cloud teams to build high-performance services, pipelines, and tooling that accelerate ML experimentation and production workflows.
  • Drive engineering excellence across teams through code reviews, design reviews, and the establishment of standards, patterns, and best practices.
  • Lead cross-functional technical initiatives and represent engineering in conversations with senior leadership and external stakeholders.
  • Contribute to product strategy by bringing deep technical insight to roadmap discussions, build-vs-buy decisions, and competitive differentiation.
  • Lead by example. Provide technical mentorship to software engineers on the team, fostering a culture of continuous learning, optimization, and rigorous engineering discipline.

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 2 years in Principal, Lead, or Staff capacity shipping enterprise-grade software.
  • Expert-level programming skills in Python and Go, with an emphasis on writing production-quality, well-tested, and modular code.
  • Experience in machine learning, statistics, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Experience building or operating production AI/ML systems, including model lifecycle management, data/training pipelines, and monitoring.
  • Expertise in applying machine learning or data science techniques to cybersecurity use cases such as anomaly detection, behavioral analysis, or threat classification.
  • Advanced understanding of threat detection methodologies, intrusion prevention systems, and incident response workflows.

Preferred Qualifications

  • A strong fundamental understanding of network telemetry and protocols.
  • Prior experience working in the cybersecurity domain. Familiarity with threat actor techniques and common network attack vectors.
  • Familiarity with machine learning applications in cybersecurity.
  • Understanding of threat detection, intrusion prevention, and incident response strategies.
  • Deep experience with cloud services on AWS or Azure.
  • Deep experience with containerization and orchestration technologies including Docker and Kubernetes at production scale.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence technical and non-technical audiences at the executive level.

The salary range for this role is $175,000 - $198,000 + bonus + benefits

ABOUT EXTRAHOP

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

OUR VALUES

Our culture is rooted in our five Values. These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team.

Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.

Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company.

Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.

Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.

Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team.

BENEFITS

Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team. Employees and their families will have the option to participate in the following benefits:

  • Health, Dental, and Vision Benefits
  • Flexible PTO, Sick Time Prorated Based on Date of Hire, and All Federal Holidays (US Only) + 3 Days of Paid Volunteer Time
  • Non-Commissioned Positions may be eligible to participate in the Annual Discretionary Bonus Plan
  • FSA and Dependent Care Accounts + EAP, where applicable
  • Educational Reimbursement
  • 401k with Employer Match or Pension where applicable
  • Pet Insurance (US Only)
  • Parental Leave (US Only)
  • Hybrid and Remote Work Model

Our people are our most important competitive advantage, leading the charge against cyber criminals. Join the fight today!

To learn more, visit our website or follow us on LinkedIn.

Interested?

Send us your application and CV and tell us a little about yourself, why this role interests you and what you think you'd bring to the team.

title: Billing Systems Architect
description: Headquarters: Remote • Anywhere About Upsun (formerly Platform.sh) Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It is built for today’s hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and humans focus on solving the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale confidently without wrestling with backend infrastructure. We give you your time back. You get: Predictable performance, even at scale Secure, compliant environments by default Real-time observability and profiling built in Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds AI-ready features that plug directly into your stack The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation. Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum. What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work. Our values: We make a positive impact. We aim for the stars. We care for each other. Impact of a Billing Systems Architect As an Enterprise Billing Systems Architect at Upsun, you are the technical anchor of our billing infrastructure, playing a vital role in ensuring our revenue operations, pricing structures, and financial integrations run seamlessly as our business scales. Picking up primary ownership from our implementation partner, you serve as the dedicated technical lead bridging Finance, Product, and Engineering. You’re deeply analytical, systems-minded, and collaborative—someone who thrives on translating complex business, pricing, and accounting rules into reliable system logic. Working downstream from our core engineering and data mediation teams, you ensure the integrity of our Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) platform while continuously optimizing platform performance and automation. Beyond day-to-day platform administration, you contribute to the long-term evolution of our billing architecture—supporting new pricing model launches, complex usage rating schemes, and financial system integrations. Your attention to detail, technical versatility, and cross-functional mindset ensure our revenue pipeline remains scalable, compliant, and friction-free. What to expect Billing Infrastructure & Administration: Serve as the hands-on technical owner of our BillingPlatform environment, configuring catalogs, price cards, usage rating rules, and automated invoice schedules. System Operations & Maintenance: Own ongoing platform health, including system updates, pricing launches, recurring bill-run troubleshooting, sync exception handling, and root-cause issue resolution. Data Ingestion & Analysis: Utilize SQL to perform data validation, rating engine auditing, and operational reporting while collaborating with Engineering to receive mediated usage data (e.g., via DigitalRoute or Kafka). Integrations & API Management: Maintain and optimize clean, API-driven integrations connecting BillingPlatform to upstream CRMs (e.g. Salesforce), downstream ERP/GL tools (e.g., NetSuite), and payment gateways (e.g., Stripe). Revenue Recognition Alignment: Partner closely with Accounting to ensure system rating rules, revenue schedules, and general ledger mappings satisfy ASC 606 and IFRS 15 compliance standards. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Gather technical and operational requirements directly from Accounting, Finance, Sales Ops, and Product teams, translating their vision into sustainable platform configuration. Data Integrity & Migration: Maintain billing data continuity and manage subscription data updates or migrations without disrupting ongoing financial operations or revenue recognition flows. What you bring Q2C Platform Experience: Proven hands-on experience configuring and administering enterprise Quote-to-Cash or billing platforms (e.g., Zuora, Salesforce Revenue Cloud/CPQ, NetSuite Billing, Aria Systems, or BillingPlatform). Data & Technical Skills: Strong proficiency with SQL for querying and auditing billing data, alongside a solid grasp of REST APIs, webhooks, and ETL workflows. Modern Pricing Expertise: Experience supporting complex SaaS or infrastructure pricing models—such as PLG, hybrid commitment-plus-usage, tiered rates, and consumption-based/metered billing. Revenue Recognition Knowledge: Practical understanding of rev rec fundamentals (ASC 606 / IFRS 15) and how accounting rules dictate billing engine design. Cross-Functional Communication: Ability to bridge technical language and financial business logic, effectively collaborating with engineering teams and accounting stakeholders alike. Problem Solving & Troubleshooting: A methodical approach to diagnosing system sync errors, rating anomalies, and integration edge cases to ensure operational continuity. Bonus points Experience with DigitalRoute mediation software or Kafka event-stream data intake Previous exposure to cloud infrastructure, PaaS, or developer-platform usage metrics Background supporting system migrations from implementation partners into internal teams Where we hire At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend - it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Spain, the United Kingdom, and the United States . Although we’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries. How we hire We know that a great hire won’t meet every requirement that we’ve outlined. If you can see yourself elevating the team, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here had we not taken a chance. You can expect 5 video interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below. Should you successfully move through the entire process you will have the opportunity to meet with a variety of Upsunners. Our goal is to ensure you can make the most informed decision on whether this role, and our culture aligns with what you’re looking for in your future working environment. 45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition 60 Minutes with Hiring Manager (Senior Director, FP&A and IT) 60 Minutes with Team (Engineering team) 60 Minutes with Team (Finance team) 45 Minutes with Executive (CFO) All roles require background checks. What we offer A product you can believe in - Join us in transforming how businesses build and manage web applications, driven making a positive impact as a proud B Corp . An Award-Winning Workplace - We’ve been recognized by Forbes’ Top 30 Companies for Remote Jobs and France’s Best Workplaces for Women. ️ A culture that values your voice - Join a flexible, open, and inclusive work environment where your voice is encouraged, and your ideas shape our growth and evolution. A global team - Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the world, embracing different perspectives Benefits and perks - Make the most of what matters to you Flexible PTO Comprehensive healthcare coverage (UK, Canada, France, Spain, USA) Company stock options Professional development budget Office equipment budget ‍️ Wellness budget Annual team gatherings Internet reimbursement Inclusive parental leave ️ Remote work travel program You belong here At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. If you need accommodations at any stage of our hiring process, please let us know. We're here to ensure an accessible and comfortable experience for you. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/platform-sh-billing-systems-architect

What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.

Our values: 

We make a positive impact.

We aim for the stars.

We care for each other. 

Impact of a Billing Systems Architect

As an Enterprise Billing Systems Architect at Upsun, you are the technical anchor of our billing infrastructure, playing a vital role in ensuring our revenue operations, pricing structures, and financial integrations run seamlessly as our business scales. Picking up primary ownership from our implementation partner, you serve as the dedicated technical lead bridging Finance, Product, and Engineering.

You’re deeply analytical, systems-minded, and collaborative—someone who thrives on translating complex business, pricing, and accounting rules into reliable system logic. Working downstream from our core engineering and data mediation teams, you ensure the integrity of our Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) platform while continuously optimizing platform performance and automation.

Beyond day-to-day platform administration, you contribute to the long-term evolution of our billing architecture—supporting new pricing model launches, complex usage rating schemes, and financial system integrations. Your attention to detail, technical versatility, and cross-functional mindset ensure our revenue pipeline remains scalable, compliant, and friction-free.

What to expect

  • Billing Infrastructure & Administration: Serve as the hands-on technical owner of our BillingPlatform environment, configuring catalogs, price cards, usage rating rules, and automated invoice schedules.

  • System Operations & Maintenance: Own ongoing platform health, including system updates, pricing launches, recurring bill-run troubleshooting, sync exception handling, and root-cause issue resolution.

  • Data Ingestion & Analysis: Utilize SQL to perform data validation, rating engine auditing, and operational reporting while collaborating with Engineering to receive mediated usage data (e.g., via DigitalRoute or Kafka).

  • Integrations & API Management: Maintain and optimize clean, API-driven integrations connecting BillingPlatform to upstream CRMs (e.g. Salesforce), downstream ERP/GL tools (e.g., NetSuite), and payment gateways (e.g., Stripe).

  • Revenue Recognition Alignment: Partner closely with Accounting to ensure system rating rules, revenue schedules, and general ledger mappings satisfy ASC 606 and IFRS 15 compliance standards.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Gather technical and operational requirements directly from Accounting, Finance, Sales Ops, and Product teams, translating their vision into sustainable platform configuration.

  • Data Integrity & Migration: Maintain billing data continuity and manage subscription data updates or migrations without disrupting ongoing financial operations or revenue recognition flows.

What you bring

  • Q2C Platform Experience: Proven hands-on experience configuring and administering enterprise Quote-to-Cash or billing platforms (e.g., Zuora, Salesforce Revenue Cloud/CPQ, NetSuite Billing, Aria Systems, or BillingPlatform).

  • Data & Technical Skills: Strong proficiency with SQL for querying and auditing billing data, alongside a solid grasp of REST APIs, webhooks, and ETL workflows.

  • Modern Pricing Expertise: Experience supporting complex SaaS or infrastructure pricing models—such as PLG, hybrid commitment-plus-usage, tiered rates, and consumption-based/metered billing.

  • Revenue Recognition Knowledge: Practical understanding of rev rec fundamentals (ASC 606 / IFRS 15) and how accounting rules dictate billing engine design.

  • Cross-Functional Communication: Ability to bridge technical language and financial business logic, effectively collaborating with engineering teams and accounting stakeholders alike.

  • Problem Solving & Troubleshooting: A methodical approach to diagnosing system sync errors, rating anomalies, and integration edge cases to ensure operational continuity.

 

Bonus points

  • Experience with DigitalRoute mediation software or Kafka event-stream data intake

  • Previous exposure to cloud infrastructure, PaaS, or developer-platform usage metrics

  • Background supporting system migrations from implementation partners into internal teams

Where we hire

At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend - it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Spain, the United Kingdom, and the United States. Although we’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries. 

How we hire

We know that a great hire won’t meet every requirement that we’ve outlined. If you can see yourself elevating the team, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here had we not taken a chance.   

You can expect 5 video interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below. Should you successfully move through the entire process you will have the opportunity to meet with a variety of Upsunners. Our goal is to ensure you can make the most informed decision on whether this role, and our culture aligns with what you’re looking for in your future working environment. 

  1. 45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition 
  2. 60 Minutes with Hiring Manager (Senior Director, FP&A and IT)
  3. 60 Minutes with Team (Engineering team)
  4. 60 Minutes with Team (Finance team)
  5. 45 Minutes with Executive (CFO)

All roles require background checks.

What we offer

A product you can believe in - Join us in transforming how businesses build and manage web applications, driven making a positive impact as a proud B Corp.

An Award-Winning Workplace - We’ve been recognized by Forbes’ Top 30 Companies for Remote Jobs and France’s Best Workplaces for Women.

️ A culture that values your voice - Join a flexible, open, and inclusive work environment where your voice is encouraged, and your ideas shape our growth and evolution.

A global team - Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the world, embracing different perspectives

Benefits and perks - Make the most of what matters to you

Flexible PTO

Comprehensive healthcare coverage (UK, Canada, France, Spain, USA)

Company stock options

Professional development budget

Office equipment budget

‍️ Wellness budget

Annual team gatherings

Internet reimbursement

Inclusive parental leave

️ Remote work travel program

You belong here

At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. If you need accommodations at any stage of our hiring process, please let us know. We're here to ensure an accessible and comfortable experience for you.

title: Social Comms
description: Important: This is a contract/part-time role: 10-20 hrs/week - rate $40-50/hr NOPE is an AI safety company with a unique goal; we do not concern ourselves with bio or cyber-risks or other Hollywood-ized alignment fantasies. We are concerned instead with the massive proliferation of relationships between humans and AI and how this affects our wellbeing and societal fabrics. Billions of conversations between people and AI are accumulating into relationships. This ranges children talking to toys, adults with AI companions, or elderly people engaging with healthcare assistants. We measure real conversations and relationships, and the trajectories of risks involved, and publish what we find, so platforms (and society) can decide when and how to act. We build ML models, track incidents, analyze new regulations, and run evaluations constantly on both raw LLMs and deployed AI. We believe you cannot foster safe and aligned AI without proprer governance and scrutiny into AI as it is truly deployed and productized. The eval space in AI is currently heavily oriented to raw LLM evals unfortuntely. We seek to change that. We seek to hold AI labs and products to account for the harms they produce. Our mission is malleable and always changing, and we search for people who seek to help define that. The Social Comms role : We are doing quite a lot but are very limited on social-and-community-driving capacity. The incidents and regulations we track, the whitepapers, plus our evaluations, are all lacking our commentary and voice. We want to increase our social media presence significantly and start to be a more active participant in the global conversation around AI safety and alignment. As our social-comms person you'd take artifacts and research we produce and weave them into a consistent, human presence on the prevalent social channels: deciding what gets posted, writing it, engaging with the researchers, journalists, builders and policymakers already wrestling with these questions. You're a pundit, optimist, skeptic, researcher and writer all rolled into one.Â The measure of your work would be whether the right people are actually engaging: researchers, builders, journalists, policymakers, and the ordinary users who sense something is off. No growth-hacking or engagement bait please. We would rather stay small and authoritative than sound like a brand. The work is async, any timezone, and you'd have direct access to the passionate team and to everything we publish before it's public. You will have a significant say and authorship of our blog (nascent stages still), linkedin, other social accounts, public spaces, and private community spaces that you recommend. Anything relevant to our work. You'd be a great fit if You care deeply about what AI is doing to human relationships and social norms; you're concerned and curious. You understand how LLMs work at an abstract level and the flaws they have. You've run or grown popular social accounts before. You write like a person, and you don't lean on AI to think or post for you. You can read a piece of research and find the three lines people will actually care about. You can disagree with strangers thoughtfully in public, critics included. You have a feel for which channels matter, and which ones aren't worth our time. You have experience in civic domains, public-good, policy, trust-and-safety, or non-profits. Bonus: you have already published material relevant to AI and its proliferation and risks. Please mention the word **AWARD** and tag RNC4yNDYuNzAuMTE2 when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RNC4yNDYuNzAuMTE2). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. description: Headquarters: Remote, Ontario, Canada About CircleCI Engineering CI/CD has been solved. Now it's being reinvented. AI agents don't just run pipelines. They write code, trigger builds, interpret failures, and propose fixes. The interfaces that developers use to understand and trust that work don't exist yet. We're building them. At CircleCI, our guiding principles aren't posters on a wall. We learn fast: we run experiments, accept failure, and scale what works. We think like the customer: every decision connects back to the developer sitting in front of a failing build at 2 am. We own the outcome: not just our slice of it, but the whole thing. If that's how you already work, you'll fit here. Team-Agnostic Placement We don't hire for a team. We hire for CircleCI. Where you land depends on where your strengths create the most leverage, and we figure that out together. You might own the CI pipeline experience, deploy and release tooling, notification infrastructure, monetization flows, AI agent surfaces, or the foundational web platform. The through line across all of it is the same: full-stack ownership, a high bar for craft, and work that directly shapes how tens of thousands of developers experience CircleCI every day. What You'll Do Build AI-natively. AI is how we work. It's not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how problems get approached and solved. Set technical direction. You define the approach others build from. When the problem is complex or the answer isn't obvious, you're the person who leads the design discussion, writes the ADR, and makes the call. Invent new interfaces. Software delivery is being reinvented. Pipelines run autonomously, generate fixes, and surface results that need human judgment. The tools developers use to understand, trust, and act on that work don't exist yet. You'll define what they look like and establish the patterns the team builds on. Own the full stack. Build features end-to-end in Go, React, and TypeScript. You don't hand off at a layer boundary. You own the outcome. Obsess over craft. Reliability and responsiveness are design concerns, not afterthoughts. Care about how the interface holds up when stakes are high and hold your team to that same standard. Champion observability. Use Honeycomb, Datadog, and Rollbar to understand and improve your systems. Operational data drives stability, not just incident response. Close gaps and fix the conditions that created them. You'll notice gaps and close them. When a gap reflects something broken in how the team works, you fix that too. What You'll Bring AI-native engineering practices. You use AI tools daily and can speak to what you've built, where they changed your approach, and where they fall short. A track record of shipping. You've built something real and put it in front of users. 5+ years of production full-stack experience, with latency, responsiveness, and reliability treated as design concerns, not afterthoughts. Full-stack depth. Strong React and TypeScript. Comfortable owning backend services in Go: API design, data modeling, service integration. System design. You lead architectural decisions on complex systems. You make conscious tradeoffs, document your reasoning, and create the foundation others build on. Adaptability. You don't just thrive in ambiguity, you reduce it for others. You turn unclear requirements into a direction the team can execute on. Technical leadership. You mentor engineers, give direct feedback on technical direction, and raise the quality bar through how you engage in reviews and design discussions, not just what you ship. Sound like you? You've stopped waiting for AI to mature and are already building with it, not as a productivity trick, but as a core part of how you think about problems. You care about the product as much as the code. You're drawn to work where the patterns don't exist yet and the best answer requires you to invent it. If that's how you already operate, we want to talk. Don Norman also chairs our executive board. Join the Global Leader in Online Design and AI Education IxDF is the world's largest online design and AI education platform, with over 1,150,000 enrollments since 2002. Help us take online education to new heights Â andÂ make a meaningful impact on humankind . At IxDF, weâre not just a company but a movement dedicated to making high-quality design and AI education accessible to everyone, everywhere. We've pioneered online design education since 2002. We have over 1,150,000 enrollments and 1,583 company members, with more than 40 courses, 160 Master Classes, and thousands of open-source design resources, created by our team in collaboration with 240 industry leaders. Here's what each role leads on: Our Course Directors, UX, UI, and AI : lead what we teach and who teaches our courses and Master Classes. You reach out to industry leaders and create the invitation they say yes to. You bring your judgment to a planned course outline: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether the structure is solid. You plan and shoot courses with our Education Designers.Â This is the role described here. Our Education Designers, UX, UI, and AI : lead how design and AI are taught. You plan, structure, and create the core content, and you decide what a course participant should be able to do by the end and how they get there. Our Course Writers and Editors : lead how our courses and articles read. You make each title engaging, ensure each sentence flows, and edit the written course experience from the userâs perspective. We're a flexible team, and you'll be able to do what you excel in. Everyone on our team creates courses, and everyone works across these roles. If you're torn between two roles, apply for the one you'd be best at, and tell us in your application which other one you considered and why. You, the Course Director , decide what belongs in our curriculum and who should teach it. You reach out to the worldâs leading experts, plan the courses with them, and shoot courses with them. When an Education Designer brings you a course outline, you're the one who says what's missing, what doesn't belong, and how to optimize the learning outcome so designers can succeed today. You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design. You'll research what already exists in a topic area, so that what we build is genuinely unique. You'll look atÂ where design and AI are heading, what designers needÂ that nobody has taught well yet, andÂ what we should retireÂ because the field has already moved on. Find the people who should teach it. Â You decide a topic is worth a course, you work out who should teach it and why, you write the email, and you get the yes. Then you plan the content with the industry leader and agree what the course must leave a learner able to do. Decide what each expert should teach. Â The best designers know a great deal, and a course that tries to capture all of it becomes an information dump. You develop a point of view on what a designer genuinely needs from them, and you hold the course to it. You'll decide which skills our courses teach , both to people entering design and to experienced designers leveling up. Our goal is to help designers thrive in the age of AI and work responsibly, so their users can thrive too. Ensure our course participants finish each course with a solid portfolio project they can show a hiring manager. Help us decide what AI should do for our course participants . Personalized learning paths, constructive AI feedback on portfolio work, practice environments where people run real design tasks and get feedback. You'll also help us improve the user flows on our own platform, so that learning at IxDF is as well designed as what we teach. You'll work on this with our founders, designers, and dev team. Make an impact as you pressure-test the coursesÂ our Education Designers plan. An Education Designer sends you a course outline, and you read it against everything you know about the field and about how people learn design, then give constructive feedback on what's missing, what doesn't belong, and where the structure can be improved. Â You know the limits of your own expertise , and you research your way past them before you weigh in. You'll also plan, structure, and create courses yourself, alongside them. You're one of the people Â whose judgment the rest of the team leans on. Â You show our Education Designers what ten or twenty years in the field taught you to look for. In return, our Co-Founder, your Team Lead, and our other Course Directors give constructive feedback on the courses you lead. You'll work in aÂ diverse, highly organized, result-driven environment Â where you'll grow personally and professionally. Act as guardian of our quality bar . When a course goes out under our name, it has to be better than anything else available on the topic. On the courses and Master Classes you lead or review, you're the one who spots what's not good enough yet and works with the team to fix it. Bring your subject matter expertiseÂ to our writers, community managers, and social media team, so our design thinking stays consistent across everything we publish. You help produce Master Classes . We produce 3 per month. Over email, you reach out to designers whose work you admire, invite them to create one with us, plan the content, and produce the live session.Â Timelines vary enormously:Â with Don Norman or Vitaly Friedman it can be two weeks from first email to publication, because we work with them often. With a new expert, it can be half a year. Once the session is recorded, you get the footage and the transcript, and you decide with the Education Designers and Team Lead which existing course benefits from which snippets, and where they go. Focus on what mattersÂ as you take raw expert video material, course and Master Class transcripts and footage featuring global industry leaders, and turn it into educational material that teaches new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design. You'll work across UX design, human-computer interaction, design thinking, UI design, psychology, and AI. Design for a diverse, global audience. Â Some of our courses and Master Classes serve working designers who want to grow into more senior work. Others serve people moving into design from other fields. Often, a course will serve both in the same lesson. Getting both right without watering either down is a rewarding design challenge. Give the video teamÂ constructive feedback Â on course and Master Class videos, from on-screen text and b-roll to graphics and animation, so each video is engaging to learn from and accurate from a design perspective. Fly out and meet the global industry leaders in design in professional studios across the world. Â You'll shoot the course content there with some of your colleagues. Expect this a few times a year at minimum. Some of us love that part and join every studio production; others keep it to those few trips. Both work for us. On averageÂ we shoot 4-6 new courses per year. Expect to have several courses moving at once at different stages: one you're planning with an expert, one being shot, one in production, and one published course that you're reviewing and improving. Find room for improvement Â by looking at completion rates, learner feedback, and the portfolios course participants produce, then go back and fix what isn't excellent yet. Use the power of incremental, modular design as you help push the quality of our educational materials to new heights, surpassing even the very best in industry and academia. We're always learning, always improving, always raising the bar in everything we do and ship. Maintain and improve our crystal-clear documentationÂ so our knowledge resources stay up-to-date, easy to find, and provide instant value to our internal teams. Clarity is key. Any line of documentation should be self-explanatory. We're proud to have assembledÂ a remarkable team of unicornsÂ who uplift, motivate, and push each other to excel daily. There's a seat open for someone who shares our passion for excellence. Could that be you? About You You have at least Â 10 years of hands-on design experience. Thirty is not too many. You have aÂ network among designers you respect , and you'reÂ comfortable writing to someone you admire Â and presenting them with an opportunity. You know what the design community wants to see, and what it needs to learn. You're kind, and you have theÂ social intelligence and empathy to Â engage well with very different kinds of people. Much of this job is convincing busy, accomplished people that what we're building is worth their time. You can show us something you built or led : a product, a design team, a course, an AI teaching app, or a conference track. We're excited to hear what it was, your thinking behind it, how long it took you to create, what went wrong, and how you improved it. You can take aÂ broad, complex design practice and turn it into a step-by-step learning sequence Â that'll make a beginner feel and act confident. You can look at a plan for teaching something andÂ see what's missing Â before anyone builds it. You're aÂ practical idealist . You know how to create great results through incremental quick wins and MVPs, and you know when to go all in and make something perfect. Youâre aÂ forward thinker Â who isnât afraid to innovate and try new things before others have. YouÂ collaborate with AI in everything you do . You use AI to research, structure, write, and create faster, and you know how to take Â human leadership , so theÂ outcome is 100% yoursÂ and better than you could have created without AI. YouâreÂ eager to help people build UX and UI skills Â because you know theyâre more relevant than ever in the age of AI. You canÂ teach a career changer Â the powerful skills of great design, and you canÂ guide an experienced designer Â in upskilling. Perhaps you've mentored people, or youâve run your own company helping clients level up. YouÂ give constructive feedback people can act on , and you can tell a talented colleague how they can improve their work without them becoming defensive. You're genuinelyÂ curious Â about how AI is changing design work and design education. You'reÂ fluent in written and spoken English Â and you can explain complex ideas clearly. Youâre enthusiastic about learning by doing and areÂ committed to putting in the effort to continuously improve your skills . YouÂ spot problems Â before anyone else notices them, and when something goes off track you come back with a solution rather than a report. YouÂ value teamwork , prioritize collaboration, and focus on collective goals and harmony in the workplace. You'reÂ self-motivated , and you loveÂ creative freedom ,Â independent judgment , and theÂ responsibility Â that comes with both. Youâre driven by the desire toÂ make a positive impact in the world Â and to improve the lives of others. If you still love designing in Figma and building interfaces with AI, there's room for that here. Some of our Course Directors design hands-on; others have moved fully into direction. Both work for us. Most of the work happens from yourÂ home office,Â but you'reÂ willing to travel a few times a year Â to shoot courses. You're located in aÂ time zone Â between UTC-6 (Austin, Chicago) and UTC+8 (Singapore, Perth), which includes all of Europe. Bonus Points None of these are required, but each of them would make us even happier. You'veÂ led a design team. YouÂ publish your own thinking on design : articles, a book, educational material, a blog, or a social media presence. You've Â spoken at design conferences , or you're on a first-name basis with people who do. You'veÂ created design systems . Organizing complex material so other people can put it to use is a lot of what you'll be doing. You've worked as anÂ editor , or you've createdÂ online courses . You have the graphic design skills to create image-based and interactive content for courses, articles, and social media. You'veÂ built AI-supported learning tools Â yourself, or you've used AI to build products. You hold aÂ bachelor's or master's Â degree in UX, UI, HCI , Â AI, or a similar field. YouâveÂ collaborated with video production teams . What We Can Offer A highly valued role : You'll shape our core product, our courses and Master Classes. Reach and impact that are difficult to find anywhere else in this field. Â A design leader might shape the work of thirty people on their team. Your decisions about what we teach will reach hundreds of thousands. They'll build better careers and design a better world for all of us. Access:Â the designers you'd normally see on a conference stage are the people you'll email, plan with, and sit across from in a studio. Our name opens doors. An email from IxDF gets read, so the reach you have now is the floor, not the ceiling. Autonomy : Nobody will ever hand you a template and tell you to fill it in. A global, purpose-driven team: work remotelyÂ alongside passionate professionals from all over the world, united by aÂ common mission Â to create the best possible design and AI education in the world and make it accessible for everyone. Our co-founder and co-CEO, Rikke, will work closely with you . She and our other co-founder, Mads, built IxDF from nothing, with no investment capital, so we would stay free to make world-class design education affordable to everyone. She was the sole editor and video editor for many of our early years, so she's shaped our course planning, expert interviews, video shoots, and content editing from the inside. She's still hands-on in everything we do, and she still films educational videos herself, in places like the US, the North Pole, and Nepal. AÂ full-time position Â within a fully remote organization. Video-based collaboration with your colleagues from elsewhere on the planet, and we get together in person each year, on a team trip or for a studio production. Bi-weeklyÂ knowledge-sharing sessions Â and 4 meeting-free days weekly for focused work. A work culture with noÂ fluffy titles, political agendas, or corporate drama . Your colleagues valueÂ your warm character, your strong work ethic, and the results you deliver . If you embody old-school virtues of always striving to deliver results, learn and become better every day, you'll thrive at IxDF. A daily mission to help impact,Â empower, and enrich the lives of millions of people Â by creatingÂ affordable high-end design education Â for everyone across the planet. It'll be yours too. Colleagues with four to forty years of experience , and a culture where we follow the best idea, not the longest rÃ©sumÃ©. A companyÂ where the distance between idea and execution is minimal. Â We're a highly agile organization withÂ zero bureaucracy or corporate politics Â â and withÂ exceptional order and efficiency . A company culture where Â passion meets high performance and excellence . To help us improve the world, and yourself in the process,Â you'll need grit, strong work ethic, long-term thinking, and self-discipline . We thrive because we have aÂ hands-on attitude and a bias towards action Â as opposed to fluff-filled, unrealistic strategies. You'll needÂ crisp execution skills yourself Â and the ability toÂ impress your colleagues with concrete results , just like they'll impress you. We built online design education before people believed in it. AI is now changing what designers do, and they carry a bigger responsibility than ever. You'll be at theÂ forefront of teaching designers to work with AI and to design responsibly for it . You'll helpÂ set a direction Â that shapes both the designers we teach and the people who use what they build. Together, we'll design a better world. You, the Course Writer and Editor, own how our courses and Master Classes read: the scripts, hooks, headings, on-screen text in videos, quiz wording, and editorial voice across everything we publish. OurÂ Education DesignersÂ hand you the structure and the exercises, and they'll often hand you draft headings and hooks along with them. The final wording is yours. You'll work closely with ourÂ Co-Founder, your Team Lead, the Education Designers, and the Course Directors, and you'll have a real say in what we make. You'll also work closely with the video team and our growth team.

Your Role at IxDF

  • Be a core part of our Editorial Team.Â You'll collaborate with IxDF editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders toÂ create educational content for people worldwide. You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with skills inÂ timeless, human-centered design and AI.

  • Make an impact as you decide how every course sounds.Â The title people want to click, the first paragraph that hooks them, the on-screen words that make our learners remember and apply what our experts teach. Our Education Designers create the structure and draft the headings, hooks, and quizzes. You finalize the scripts, hooks, headings, quiz wording, and editorial voice across everything we publish, and you give proactive feedback on the structure.

  • You don't need a design background.Â Most of our writers and editors start without one, and that can be an advantage because you're coming to design the way many of our learners do. In your first year you'll learn it from the inside, working through it sentence by sentence with the people who teach it, until you know what a course participant needs.

  • Write for a diverse, global audience.Â Some of our courses and Master Classes serve experienced designers who want to grow into more senior work. Others serve people moving into design from other fields, and many are not reading in their first language. Often, you'll write for all of them at the same time. Getting that balance right without watering anything down is a rewarding editorial challenge.

  • Be the voice of IxDF.Â Our reputation lives in every sentence we publish, and many of those sentences will be yours.Â Represent a global movement dedicated to design education, and take pride in it. It's a big responsibility, and a rewarding one.

  • Set and raise the standard for our assessments, so a correct answer proves understanding, not just recognition, and a good question teaches as well as tests. Our Education Designers decide what a question has to test. You write the wording that does both.

  • Balance the big picture with the smaller details.Â Expect to focus on one large course creation project per month, alongside small, continuous improvements to what's already published. You'll also write and edit articles, course descriptions, and supporting material, and help our Growth team and our two founders get the voice right in campaigns and social copy.

  • Turn expert material into lessons.Â Once you've built an understanding of design, you'll take a one-hour Master Class transcript and the learning goals for what the lesson must teach, then turn the strongest sections into a finished lesson. We produce 3 Master Classes per month, so new expert material arrives continuously.

  • Our coursesÂ combine written and video lessons.Â You'll work closely with the video team, givingÂ constructive feedbackÂ on on-screen text, b-roll, graphics, and animation, and telling them which takeaways need a visual, so each video is more engaging to learn from.

  • Find room for improvementÂ by looking at completion rates, learner feedback, and the portfolios learners produce, then go back and fix what isn't excellent yet. Small, incremental edits are why our material surpasses even the very best in industry and academia.Â We're always learning, always improving, always raising the barÂ in everything we do.

  • Weâre committed toâ¯excellence, and we seek a like-minded enthusiast to join us. This role isâ¯not for the average. Ahead of you is aâ¯highly rewarding and enriching journey.

  • Maintain and improve ourÂ crystal-clear documentationÂ so our knowledge resources stay up-to-date, easy to find, and provide instant value to our internal teams. Clarity is key. Any line of documentation should be self-explanatory.

  • You won't do this alone.Â You'll work with our Education Designers, Course Directors, your Team Lead, and our Co-Founder to pressure-test the material: you'll add what's missing, delete what's redundant, and suggest how to improve the structure. You'll be working with people who have anything from 4 to 40 years of design experience, ready to share their knowledge. We'll also help you upskill so you can grow a designer's eye alongside your editor's ear. You'll work in a diverse, highly organized, result-driven environment where you'll developÂ personally and professionally.

  • We're proud to have assembled aÂ remarkable team of unicornsÂ who uplift, motivate, and push each other to excel daily. There's a seat open for someone who shares our passion for excellence. Could that be you?

Do You Share IxDF's Vision?

  • You're genuinelyÂ curiousÂ about how AI is changing design work and design education, and you look for new ways to use it in your own work.

Description

Job Summary:

The BESS Project Scheduler is responsible for developing, maintaining, and analyzing detailed project schedules for Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects. This role plays a critical part in ensuring projects are delivered on time by providing accurate schedule forecasts, identifying risks, and supporting project teams with data-driven insights across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and energization phases. This role requires a strong leader that will take ownership of driving accurate and up to date scheduling across multiple projects as well as taking initiative to drive process improvements where there is an opportunity to improve.

Job Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain integrated project schedules for BESS projects from NTP through COD
  • Build schedules covering engineering, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, civil, electrical, installation, commissioning, and grid interconnection
  • Collaborate with Project Managers, Construction Managers, OEMs, and subcontractors to validate logic, durations, and sequencing
  • Perform critical path analysis, float analysis, and schedule risk assessments
  • Track project progress and update schedules using actuals, forecasts, and recovery plans
  • Identify schedule impacts related to procurement delays, permitting, weather, interconnection, or change orders
  • Prepare schedule narratives, look-ahead schedules, and progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
  • Support claims, change management, and time-impact analyses as required
  • Ensure schedules align with contract milestones, EPC agreements, and owner requirements
  • Maintain schedule standards, templates, and best practices across the portfolio
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements

  • Bachelorâs degree in construction management, Engineering, Project Management, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 5+ years of project scheduling experience in utility-scale energy, power generation, or heavy civil construction
  • Direct experience supporting BESS, solar, wind, or substation projects
  • Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 (required)
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Project and Excel
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, procurement lead times, and commissioning activities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with EPC contracts and utility-scale energy storage projects
  • Knowledge of battery OEM workflows (manufacturing, FAT, shipping, commissioning)
  • Familiarity with Power BI or other reporting/analytics tools
  • Experience supporting schedule recovery plans and delay analysis
  • Experience developing resource-loaded and cost-loaded schedules
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to present schedule data clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Work Environment/Physical Requirements

  • Combination of office, remote, and active construction site environments
  • Ability to work extended hours during critical project phases
  • Working in all weather conditions
  • Must be able to lift more than 50 lbs.
  • May require overtime, nights, or weekends based on project needs

Pre-Employment Requirements

Candidates must successfully complete a background check and drug screening prior to hiring. This role is considered safety-sensitive and may be subject to ongoing drug and testing in compliance with company policy and regulatory requirements.

Location: Location specific; travel up to 50%

TAKKION is an Equal Opportunity Employer

description: RainFocus, one of the most innovative software companies, is in search of an exceptional Senior Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) Analyst . About RainFocus RainFocus cares about its employees, customers, and the world in which we live. Our rapidly growing team serves Fortune 500 companies like Adobe, Cisco, IBM, Oracle, VMware, and others to prepare and execute in-person, virtual, and hybrid events across the world. Those events are delivered through our industry-disrupting software platform, with groundbreaking business intelligence, to elevate the attendee experience, streamline event operations, and accelerate marketing results. We are well-funded, growing fast, and building a company that is changing the market â it will be challenging, fun, and exciting. About the Role We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior GRC Analyst to join our Security and Privacy team. In this role, you will own and grow RainFocus's governance, risk, and compliance program â maintaining our control framework, leading risk assessments, supporting audits, and driving the program's maturity forward rather than simply maintaining the status quo. You will report directly to the CISO and have significant ownership from day one. \n Key Responsibilities: Lead RainFocus's GRC program across SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and other client/regulatory compliance frameworks, including audit prep, evidence collection, and auditor relationships. Manage and mature our control framework, mapping new regulations and conducting gap assessments. Own the annual security risk assessment process (NIST SP 800-30 methodology), including stakeholder interviews, risk scoring, and residual risk tracking. Maintain and update security policies, standards, and documentation to ensure compliance with industry best practices. Partner with Engineering and Security to mature vulnerability management and secrets-scanning practices, moving these from reactive to proactive, pre-deployment controls. Help build out and operationalize a Data Loss Prevention (DLP) program, including policy design and rollout across email, endpoint, and cloud storage. Grow and mature RainFocus's security awareness training program. Drive AI governance efforts â policy, tooling, and monitoring for approved vs. unapproved AI tool usage across the company. Identify and help close Shadow IT / unmanaged SaaS visibility gaps in partnership with IT. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement risk management practices and ensure compliance across the organization. Respond to security and privacy inquiries from clients, partners, and employees. Prepare and present reports on the organization's security and privacy compliance status, including program maturity and remediation progress. Stay abreast of emerging security threats, vulnerabilities, and compliance requirements. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field is highly desirable. 6+ years of proven experience in GRC, IT audit, information security compliance, or a related field. In-depth knowledge of relevant regulations, standards, and frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, NIST 800-series, GDPR, and others). Experience running or contributing heavily to formal risk assessments â not just tracking a compliance checklist. Professional certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CISSP, CIPP, or CIPM are highly desirable. Familiarity with modern security tooling such as Drata, OneTrust, Vanta, etc. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Experience with cloud security and compliance frameworks is a plus. Experience with OneTrust or related GRC technologies is a plus. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement risk management practices and ensure compliance across the organization.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

If you want your work to touch hundreds of millions of end‑users (and help the developers behind them get paid), you’ll fit right in. The role: We are looking for a Senior, proactive DevOps / DevEx Engineer to join our engineering team and help building and scaling the internal development platform. We want to provide autonomy, build a self-serve culture that allows teams to move fast but ensures safety and best practices. Your job is to take all this to the next level. About you: You are a builder: You don't just use tools; you build them. You have 5+ years of experience in SRE, DevOps, DevEx or Platform Engineering with a heavy emphasis on software development. You are proactive: You see what is needed, you take action and own problems to turn them into solutions. You love building frameworks, abstractions and automation: You see that the best way to ensure best practices are follow is to make something so easy and joyfull to use that nobody wants to use anything else. You are AI-curious: You understand how LLMs and AI coding tools are changing engineering and want to help a world-class team leverage them effectively. You move fast , test and iterate quickly. Preferred Experience: Experience with AWS cloud, k8s, docker, IaC, Github Solid knowledge of Python In the first month, you'll: Meet your team! Get up to speed on our unique infrastructure-as-code patterns. Familiarize yourself with our existing internal tools for releases, canaries, and access control. Ship your first project —improving an existing tool or automation. Within the first 3 months, you'll: Be able to scope and work on tasks self-sufficiently. Understand most of our internals tools and feel confident making changes to them. Start on-call training. Participate in code reviews, design reviews, brainstorms. Within the first 6 months, you'll: Design and ship major initiatives and have a positive impact in the engineering team. Collaborate closely with other engineers, creating ties, understanding their pain points and starting to become more involve in the roadmap and prioritization of new initiatives. Within the first 12 months, you'll: Be the go-to expert for our internal platforms, services and infrastructure abstractions. Have your own initiatives for improving DevOps and DevEx. Lead AI tool adoption across the engineering org, following well-established patterns for safety and simplicity. For each feature we ship and for each larger improvement track that spans multiple product areas, you will have a definition of key performance indicators and be accountable for their growth. You will own the acquisition funnel for this use case and understand the problems that matter the most. Together with the BI analyst, you will own dashboards to track your KPIs, as well as monitor other data sources and feedback channels, to inform your next steps and rapidly iterate to improve the product. Together with the designer and the team lead of a dedicated engineering team, you will own a process of developing new features, conducting customer interviews and ensuring proper execution with the engineering teams. Together with the Director of Product, you will align on the product strategy, get a solid understanding of how our product works, and establish a reliable product discovery & execution process. Exceptional, native-level English, both written and spoken. Exceptional communication skills to interact with colleagues, customers, and partners. Experience working on projects related to document processing is a strong plus. Experience working on customer-facing user interfaces (either in B2B or B2C products) is a strong plus. Knowledge of modern developments in ML/AI related to text processing (LLM, RAG) and overall technical background is a strong plus. Knowledge of a localization industry is a strong plus. Growth-oriented mindset. Integrity, full commitment, and a strong sense of ownership. Experience working in a highly intense startup environment, requiring extreme focus, a sense of urgency, and persistence to break through. Openness to feedback and alternative opinions and ideas. raw.title: Kodify: Senior Product Manager
raw.description:
Headquarters: Barcelona, Connecticut, Spain

Job description

At Kodify we manage several high traffic web platforms developed using the latest technologies and we work hard to provide the best experience for our users.

It is extremely important to us that anyone who joins loves sharing their taste for high-quality products and pays attention to detail. We also value respect, openness, and diversity amongst our teams. We are an international team of around 150 with 13 different nationalities, spread around the world in our different office locations: Barcelona, Altea, Montréal, Los Angeles and several other European countries for the team that works remotely.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced, strategic Senior Product Manager to lead the development and growth of our web-based products. In this role, you will own the full product lifecycle; from discovery and strategy through execution and optimization, working cross-functionally to deliver exceptional user experiences that drive business impact.


You will define product vision and roadmap, prioritize features based on user needs and business value, and partner closely with engineering, design, marketing, and analytics teams to bring products to market. This role requires both strategic thinking and hands-on execution, with a strong focus on data-driven decision making and continuous improvement.

What You'll Do

Product Strategy & Vision

  • Define and communicate product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with company objectives

  • Conduct user research, market analysis, and competitive intelligence to identify opportunities

  • Make strategic decisions on feature prioritization using frameworks like RICE, value vs. effort, and customer impact analysis

Product Development & Execution

  • Own the full product lifecycle from discovery through launch and post-launch optimization

  • Define project scope, goals, and deliverables in collaboration with stakeholders

  • Write clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical requirements for engineering teams

  • Work within Agile methodologies (SCRUM or Kanban) to manage product backlogs and sprint planning

  • Build prototypes and collaborate with UX/UI designers to create intuitive user experiences

Data & Experimentation

  • Design and oversee A/B tests and experiments to validate hypotheses and optimize conversion

  • Monitor product KPIs, user behavior analytics, and funnel performance to identify improvement opportunities

  • Conduct cohort analysis, customer segmentation, and unit economics analysis to inform decisions

  • Partner with data teams to build dashboards and reporting for product performance tracking

Stakeholder Management & Communication

  • Interface with leadership, marketing, customer support, and other teams to align on priorities

  • Present product updates, insights, and recommendations to executive stakeholders

  • Build strong relationships across the organization to facilitate cross-functional collaboration

  • Advocate for user needs while balancing business objectives and technical constraints

Growth & Optimization

  • Drive initiatives across the full customer lifecycle: acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization

  • Optimize conversion funnels, pricing strategies, and user onboarding flows

  • Build a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement within the team

  • Stay current on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in product management

What You'll Bring

Experience & Background

  • 5-7+ years of experience in product management, with a proven track record of shipping successful digital products

  • Experience managing products in high-traffic consumer web platforms, subscription businesses, e-commerce, adtech, or SaaS

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product ownership and measurable business impact

  • Deep understanding of Agile methodologies and experience working with cross-functional development teams

Technical & Analytical Skills

  • Expert-level proficiency with product analytics tools (Google Analytics, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar)

  • Hands-on experience with experimentation platforms (Optimizely, VWO, Google Optimize, or similar)

  • Solid understanding of web technologies, APIs, and technical architecture to collaborate effectively with engineering

  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills and experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar)

Product & Business Acumen

  • Strong analytical and mathematical skills with ability to translate data into actionable insights

  • Experience with conversion rate optimization (CRO), funnel analysis, and growth strategies

  • Understanding of UX/UI principles, customer journey mapping, and user research methodologies

  • Knowledge of online marketing channels, SEO fundamentals, and digital acquisition strategies

  • Familiarity with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA)

Soft Skills & Working Style

  • Exceptional communication skills with ability to influence and align stakeholders at all levels

  • Strategic thinker who can also roll up sleeves and execute tactical work

  • Data-driven decision maker who balances quantitative insights with qualitative user feedback

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and able to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

  • Collaborative team player with a growth mindset and passion for continuous learning

  • Complete fluency in English is essential

Nice to Have

  • Technical background or experience working as a developer, data analyst, or UX designer

  • Degree or postgraduate qualification in business, computer science, mathematics, statistics, or related field

  • Understanding of payment processing, subscription billing, or monetization strategies

About You

  • You're a natural leader who can inspire teams and drive alignment across diverse stakeholders

  • You have an eye for great design and user experience, with high standards for product quality

  • You balance user empathy with business pragmatism to make smart tradeoffs

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and iterating based on learnings

  • You thrive on solving complex problems and turning ambiguous challenges into clear action plans

  • You're passionate about building products that users love and that drive meaningful business results

  • You value transparency, open feedback, and continuous improvement in yourself and your team

What We Offer

  • Generous training and development budget (10% of your annual salary)

  • 2x a year company on-sites

  • 1x per year company retreat (think, Mexico, Dominican Republic…)

  • Flexible/Remote working

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 3 years with us!

  • Generous PTO

  • Day off on your Birthday

  • Extended parental leave

  • Health and Wellness Budget

  • Health insurance

  • Cool and modern office space

  • Latest tech equipment

  • Healthy snacks and drinks provided at all times

All done!

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our Infrastructure team and help build the platform that powers Truv. You'll join a small, senior team working on high-impact initiatives, from standing up our first formal observability and alerting platform to architecting infrastructure for compliance across regulated sectors. You'll work closely with engineering leadership and cross-functional teams to ensure our infrastructure is reliable, secure, and scales with our rapidly growing customer base in the banking, lending, and government sectors.


This isn't a "keep the lights on" role. We need someone who identifies gaps, proposes solutions, and drives them to completion. You'll have real ownership and the support of a tight team to ship meaningful improvements. In your first 30 days, you'll deploy changes to production. We onboard fast and trust our hires to own outcomes early.

  • Architect and scale our AWS infrastructure, including container orchestration, autoscaling, networking, and cost optimization

  • Build our observability and alerting platform from the ground up. You'll own it from design through production deployment

  • Lead infrastructure builds for compliance (SOC 2, HIPAA). We need someone who scopes, builds, and ships, not just advises

  • Harden container workloads and secrets management across production, staging, and isolated compliance environments

  • Own the shared infrastructure stack (Postgres, Redis, Celery). Find bottlenecks, fix them, and add capacity before they become incidents

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, optimizing for deploy speed, reliability, and security

  • Extend our Terraform codebase to keep environments reproducible and audit-ready. We ship IaC changes weekly, not quarterly

  • Define and own our reliability practices: SLOs, incident response, post-mortems, and the production tooling to back them up

  • Unblock engineering teams by reducing deploy friction, improving dev environments, and eliminating toil

  • Share on-call with a small team. When things break, you lead the response, run the post-mortem, and make sure the fix ships


Who You Are



  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Infrastructure Engineering roles

  • Deep expertise with AWS, including hands-on production experience operating and scaling Kubernetes clusters

  • Strong understanding of container orchestration, networking, and security in cloud-native environments

  • Solid Infrastructure as Code experience (Terraform strongly preferred)

  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with modern tooling

  • Experience with monitoring and observability platforms. We're actively building out this area and want someone who's done it before

  • You've owned projects end-to-end. Scoped the work, built it, shipped it, and operated it. Not just picked up tickets

  • You write clear decision documents (ADRs, RFCs) and can explain infrastructure tradeoffs to both engineers and leadership

  • You've built infrastructure from scratch at a fast-moving company, not just inherited mature platforms

  • You thrive in startups. You ship daily, adapt when priorities shift, and don't wait to be told what to own


Preferred skills



  • Hands-on compliance work (SOC 2 or HIPAA) in a regulated industry like fintech, healthcare, or government

  • Experience with event-driven autoscaling and async task processing systems (e.g., Celery, SQS, KEDA)

  • Experience with isolated or partitioned cloud environments for regulated workloads

  • Python scripting for automation and tooling

  • Experience with relational database administration, tuning, and scaling in production

  • Background in cost optimization and FinOps practices

  • Experience with secrets management and Kubernetes package management


Benefits



  • Fully remote

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k)

  • Flexible time off

  • Work with cutting-edge technology and innovative customers

  • Opportunity to shape the future of financial data access

Headquarters: Global / Taipei / Kuala Lumpur / Penang

Responsibilities:


1. Cloud Infrastructure Design & Operations: Design, build, and optimize highly available and secure cloud architectures on AWS.


2. CI/CD Pipeline Development: Design and maintain end-to-end pipelines from code commit to deployment — including build, test, artifact management, release, and rollback — to improve release frequency and quality.


3. Operations Automation: Reduce manual toil through programming and automation tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform, custom scripts/platforms) to automate configuration management, change execution, and incident response.


4. Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Manage AWS cloud resources and network configurations using Terraform to ensure environment consistency, auditability, and reproducibility.


5. CDN Operations: Configure, monitor, tune, and troubleshoot AWS CDN services to ensure acceleration and availability of static assets and streaming media.


6. Monitoring, Alerting & Observability: Build and maintain monitoring, logging, and distributed tracing systems to enable rapid issue identification and drive capacity and performance optimization.




 


Requirements:


1. Education & Experience:


- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field.
- 3+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, Cloud Operations, or Infrastructure Engineering.


2. Cloud Platform:


- Proficient with AWS: hands-on experience with core services including EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, Lambda, EKS/ECS.
- Solid understanding of cloud-native principles; familiar with containers (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes or AWS EKS managed service), service mesh, and serverless technologies.


3. CI/CD:


- Proficient in designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD).
- Familiar with pipeline design principles: multi-environment management, branching strategies, artifact management, blue-green/canary deployments, and rollback mechanisms.


4. Observability:


- Experience building and optimizing monitoring stacks such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki.


5. Operations Automation & Programming:


- Strong automation programming skills: proficient in at least one scripting/programming language (e.g., Shell, Python, Go) for writing automation scripts and tools.
- Able to design automation solutions for operational scenarios and integrate with existing monitoring, ticketing, and configuration management systems.


6. Infrastructure as Code (IaC):


- Proficient with Terraform: able to manage AWS resources with modular design and proven hands-on experience.
- Familiarity with Ansible for configuration management and batch operations (e.g., system initialization, application deployment, configuration distribution).


7. CDN Operations:


- Hands-on CDN operations experience: familiar with AWS CloudFront configuration, caching strategies, domain and certificate management.
- Able to perform bandwidth/traffic and cost analysis, origin optimization, troubleshooting, and SLA assurance.


8. Soft Skills:


- Strong documentation habits, communication, collaboration, and ability to drive initiatives across teams.
- Solid problem analysis and post-mortem skills; able to participate in or lead root cause analysis and drive improvement actions.


To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/coin-market-cap-devops-engineer-contractor
